name: qualisera-mobile-automation
description: Enterprise-Grade Agentic Mobile Test Automation Framework: WebdriverIO v8, Appium 2, Cucumber BDD, TypeScript, Allure & Manual QA Dashboard

scripts.test:android: wdio run wdio.android.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tags="@automated and not @manual and not @blocked"
scripts.test:web: wdio run wdio.web.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tags="@automated and not @manual and not @blocked"
scripts.test:web:smoke: wdio run wdio.web.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tags="@smoke and @web and not @manual and not @blocked"
scripts.test:web:smoke:report: npm run test:web:smoke && npm run report:open
scripts.test:web:regression: wdio run wdio.web.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tags="@regression and @web and not @manual and not @blocked"
scripts.test:feature:product-discovery: wdio run wdio.web.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tags="@feature-product-discovery and @automated and @web and not @blocked"
scripts.test:smoke: wdio run wdio.android.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tags="@smoke and @android and not @manual and not @blocked"
scripts.test:regression: wdio run wdio.android.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tags="@regression and @android and not @manual and not @blocked"
scripts.test:feature:sample: wdio run wdio.android.conf.ts --cucumberOpts.tags="@feature-sample and @automated and @android and not @blocked"
scripts.report: npm run report:generate && npm run report:open

author: Fadli Raharjo
